maria: Heads-up — sample app fncall 'sampler' mode is returning an array of candidate objects even when n_candidates=1, which breaks the TS SDK validator.
jason: ah interesting. is that from the hosted api or local stub?
maria: hosted. repro in the playground and via SDK. Python SDK tolerates it, TS helper expects a single object for function return.
aparna: I can repro with the samplekit flow. Steps: set `function_call` to `auto`, `sampler: {n_candidates:1}`, then prompt that triggers the tool. SDK returns `result: [{...}]`. Log excerpt:```json
{"tool_result": [{"name":"format_address","args":{"street":"1 Main"}}]}
```
jason: Could be the runtime sampler layer always normalizing to an array of candidates. We intended arrays for n>1 but single for n==1.
alex: Repro'd locally. Looks like the agent-runtime pipeline stage 'collectCandidates' always wraps into list. Quick patch possible in TS SDK helper to coerce `if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length===1) v = v[0]` but that's fragile.
maria: Right — we shouldn't paper over server differences. We need parity: server should follow contract or API should document "always array". Either is ok but must be consistent across SDKs.
kevin: For onboarding friction, docs mention "function responses as object" in quickstart. That's inconsistent. We need a small PR to docs + runtime or SDK.
aparna: Also saw nullable fields in schema causing validator errors in TS when candidate is array: schema has `address?` nullable and helper `coerceNullable` chokes on `[null]`.
alex: Minimal plan: 1) Add an integration test in sample-app suite that asserts parity (python & ts) for sampler outputs. 2) Decide server contract: always-array vs adaptive. 3) If we choose adaptive, implement a stable coercion helper in both SDKs with explicit opt-in and clear name.
maria: +1. For short-term, I'll open an issue to fix the docs and add a smoke test on hosted API.
kevin: Can someone sketch the test? I can land it.
jason: Test: call endpoint with sampler n=1, assert `tool_result` is object (not array) OR assert SDK unwrap option toggled. Put both expectations behind a feature-flag matrix so we can flip.
ci-bot: build/samplekit-parity-tests #124 failed on linux — see https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/124 (flaky e2e) :warning:
aparna: That CI failure is the exact flaky where the TS validator crashed because it hit `[{"args":null}]` and our `isObject` check returned false. I pushed a local fix to my fork that adds `unwrapSingleCandidate` to the SDK options.
alex: Let's avoid SDK-level heuristics that change runtime semantics. If server chooses to always return array, SDK should expose `unwrapSingleCandidate` as DX sugar but not default it.
maria: Agreed. For onboarding, default behavior should mirror server (no unwrap). Docs should show how to opt into unwrap in samplekit.
kevin: I'll add a docs patch and a test. Assign me?
maria: assigning to @kevin. Also filing runtime issue: RT-2042 'sampler single-candidate wrapping parity'.
jason: FYI also double-check auth/retry middleware — previously an auth retry path re-encoded tool args as string which made validator think it's a scalar. Could be related.
aparna: Good call. I saw one log where `args` became `{"street":"1 Main"}` after a failed auth refresh.
alex: If that's real, file RT-2043 for auth retry double-encode. We should add a test that hits an auth-refresh path.
ci-bot: New issue RT-2042 created by maria: https://tickets.internal/RT-2042
ci-bot: New issue RT-2043 created by alex: https://tickets.internal/RT-2043
maria: Thanks all. Short-term: docs + sample test from kevin. Medium: runtime decision + explicit SDK opt-in for unwrap. Long-term: ensure auth/retry path preserves types. :thumbsup:
jason: I'll add a quick e2e matrix comparing ts/python sdk output and link to the sample app.
kevin: landing docs PR shortly.
aparna: tagging this thread into the samplekit sprint board. :sparkles:
